NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author force-pushed once, dropping the six per-severity fixtures, so the PR is back to just `view.py` and `tests.py`. They then tagged Niloth-p for review without answering any of the questions in the feedback.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Separate per-severity fixtures are gone, which matches the advice to use a single fixture. |
| ❌  | The questions about which integrations and PRs they studied, and what those did about `doc.md`, are still unanswered. |
| ❌  | `doc.md` isn't in the PR's files, even though the feedback asked what the model PRs did there. |
| ❌  | The description still says the feature relies on the `include_emoji_indicators` parameter, but the author said on CZO they removed it. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer until the author answers the questions and brings the description and `doc.md` in line with the code.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Before we re-review, please answer the questions in Niloth-p's last comment, namely which existing emoji integrations you followed and what they did in `doc.md`. Also update the PR description, which still mentions `include_emoji_indicators`, so it matches the code. The [Incoming Webhooks Guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/index.html) covers docs and fixtures.
```
